context.description: Validate the final state audit with task-ui in scope and update the task-ui README

evidence.trustReason: Trust rejected for the README deliverable only; every non-N/A test case is covered and green. Test cases: (1) Happy Path SV19 - "SV19 holds exactly the AD-17 entries for both trees" pins the 14 AD-17 keys, and "passes on the current tree" asserts unlisted, unreasoned and stale are empty, so the real findings of both trees equal the allowlist; no interim entry or until field remains. (2) Invalid Input SV18 - "flags each planted construct" asserts file, identifier and rule for 27 harness and 5 task-ui constructs. (3) Boundary - "the task-ui holds no repeat, schedule, sleep, interval or signal outside fromActor" scans the real task-ui and asserts its finding keys are exactly fromActor and DISPLAY. (4) Error Propagation - the audit unit test reports a whitespace reason, and the real-tree test asserts no unreasoned entry. (5) Invalid Input task-ui - a planted Effect.sleep, Schedule.spaced or createSignal fails against the real ALLOWLIST. Runs: bun test state-audit 7 pass 0 fail; typecheck exit 0; builder sweep on a scratch copy 10/10 caught; verifier mutants 10/11 caught plus 2 controls passing (the miss is a bare Schedule alias, outside the test cases). GAP, Notes item tag classification: packages/tui/src/task-ui/README.md lines 26-28 say every grouping, the Board columns included, reads the tags and that DISPLAY gives a state name only its glyph, tone and Gantt block. The code disagrees: Display has a column field (store.ts 109-117), building/proving/verifying carry column BUILDING/PROVING/VERIFYING (store.ts 126-128), and columnOf returns DISPLAY[task.state].column for an active task (store.ts 191-197); spec.md Spec decisions says DISPLAY covers glyph, tone, Gantt block and Board column. Fix: drop only, and say DISPLAY also gives an active phase's Board column while the tags choose the column class. Details in journal/task/T4.13-verify.md.
